_doc: Plan 30 §5.2 discovery corpus: six destinations, all present in the dev catalogue (cityKey + countryCode match a discovery_destinations row) so the with-exclusions variant has a real exclusion list. claudeDestination is built exactly as routes/discovery.js and services/copilotGrounding.js build it: `${label}, ${countryNameFromCode(countryCode)} (${countryCode})`. Active-place counts were read from the dev DB on 2026-10-18 and are context for `role`, not an assertion. Plan 36 W2 adds two destinations with no dev-DB row (hoian, danang): they carry `firstOnly: true` (no exclusion capture, only the 'first' variant) and `optIn: true` (generated only when named by --only), so the default corpus stays the six above.

destinations.label: Taipei
destinations.note: 268 active places in the dev catalogue. Plan 27 W4 measured its name-quality baseline on this destination, so the defect rates are comparable to F-27-32.

destinations.label: Kuala Lumpur
destinations.note: 187 active places. The dev row's display_name is the bare city key 'kualalumpur'; the label sent to the model is the human form, as the discovery route sends what the client typed.

destinations.label: Chengdu
destinations.note: 241 active places. Local names are written in Chinese script; stresses name / localName / aliases separation.

destinations.label: 冲绳
destinations.note: 73 active places. The destination string itself is Chinese script (the stored display name), not a romanization — tests whether the model answers in the right register for a CJK-named destination.

destinations.label: Ipoh
destinations.role: mid-size city standing in for 'small town'
destinations.note: 84 active places. NOT the smallest destination in the dev copy (Kaohsiung has 56, Chongqing CN 66) — the dev catalogue has no genuine small town, so Ipoh is the closest mid-size stand-in for a place that cannot honestly fill 30 items per category.

destinations.label: Kaohsiung
destinations.note: 56 active places, the smallest in the copy; nature 5, wellness 6, culture 6, essentials 6, nightlife 7. Tests the padding defect (Plan 27 Q-27-6) where a city cannot fill every category.

destinations.label: Hoi An
destinations.note: Plan 36 W2. Not in the dev catalogue, so it has no exclusion list: first generation only (firstOnly). Opt-in (optIn): generated only when named by --only, so the standard 12-generation corpus is unchanged. Plan 36 measured a ~10k-token 'collapse' (most categories 4-7 items) on 4 of 16 such generations, and Hoi An's production essentials came back at 3. Run it with --repeat to measure a collapse rate.

destinations.label: Danang
destinations.note: Plan 36 W2. Not in the dev catalogue, so it has no exclusion list: first generation only (firstOnly). Opt-in (optIn): generated only when named by --only, so the standard 12-generation corpus is unchanged. A small city next to Hoi An, in the same size band where Plan 36 measured a ~10k-token 'collapse' (most categories 4-7 items) on 4 of 16 generations. Run it with --repeat to measure a collapse rate.

destinations.label: Luang Prabang
destinations.note: Plan 36 W3. A UNESCO small town; not in the dev catalogue, so first generation only and opt-in, like hoian. Production generated it on 2026-10-20 at 8 categories / 91 items (essentials 13).

destinations.label: Hue
destinations.note: Plan 36 W3. A small heritage city in the Hoi An / Da Nang band; not in the dev catalogue, so first generation only and opt-in, like hoian.
